note.en: AutoSynth learns an audio-conditioned autoregressive model that predicts complete, editable synthesizer programs, using a pretrained audio generation model to convert text into audio and then into programs, evaluated on synthesizer inversion and text-driven generation.
note.zh: AutoSynth 学习音频条件的自回归模型以直接预测完整可编辑的合成器程序，并借助预训练音频生成模型将文本转为音频再转为程序，在合成器反演与文本驱动生成任务上进行评估。
